documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers (India) Limited reported its Q4 FY26 earnings, marking a operational transition following the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its automated Vadodara plant. Annual revenue grew 37.7% year-on-year to INR 110.3 crores, driven by operational leverage and cost control as EBITDA margins expanded. The company plans to reach full capacity utilization at its 500 MT per month facility by the end of FY27 while shifting its revenue mix towards 50% manufacturing. Management also intends to utilize internal cash flows to reduce debt and expand into non-textile binder applications. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for the fourth quarter and full year ended FY26, highlighting growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax.

guidance.claim: Silkflex aims to increase the revenue contribution of manufacturing to 50% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching full capacity utilization at its plant by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Overall EBITDA margins are expected to expand by 200 to 300 basis points over the full financial year base.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points.

guidance.claim: Management expects distribution revenue from wood-coating to potentially double from INR 6 crores to INR 12-14 crores.
guidance.quote: Plus, our distribution of business for wood-coating, the current contribution of 6%, the growth of that can also double. Meaning we can even take it from INR6 crores to INR12 crores, INR14 crores.

guidance.claim: The company aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company by 2030.
guidance.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

guidance.claim: Management expects full capacity utilization of the new manufacturing plant by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: Manufacturing EBITDA margins are expected to reach near about 50% according to production growth.
guidance.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

guidance.claim: Total turnover from manufacturing at full utilization of the 500-ton capacity is projected around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment is cautious due to global macroeconomic uncertainties.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Awareness and government pressures are driving customer demand toward solvent-free market solutions.
demand_outlook.quote: Because now, there is a lot of awareness to get out of solvents in the market. Looking to the global situation as well as the pressure from the government.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in the textile market is expected to be 15% to 20% and in the wood coating market 20% to 30%.
demand_outlook.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara plant covers 10 acres with a 72,000 sq ft automated setup and operates on a zero-discharge model.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: Silkflex is adding new machinery funded through internal resources to broaden its product portfolio.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Future vessel installations to expand manufacturing capacity are estimated to cost between INR 3 crore and INR 5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production commenced at the first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated plant.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: Utilities, cooling plants, and monomer storage capacities were installed keeping future expansion in mind without requiring more capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, Ryan. We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration from in-house manufacturing is expected to improve EBITDA margins by 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs saw a sharp increase during the year due to global disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 increased by 180 basis points to 23.1%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin improved by 180 basis points, reaching 23.1% from 21.3% in the same period last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company transitioned from trading to manufacturing to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.
margins_costs.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 FY26 EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2% in Q3 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's Vadodara facility has an installed production capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% during the first year of plant operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: Around 80% of the plant facility space remains vacant for future capacity additions.
orders_capacity.quote: The percentage of the facility is still 80% is remaining there and that depends on our R&D once it will be done, as well as the market growth will be there, we will be fulfilling that 80% space also.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity of the new Vadodara facility is 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization in the first two months of manufacturing (November and December) was around 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: Management does not expect working capital to become a constraint due to internal liquidity and cash generation.
capital_allocation.quote: So, Nidhi ji, basically we aren't expecting that working capital as such should become any constraint in our growth, mostly because internal availability is there, and more than that our cash flow is very good.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the manufacturing setup costs, INR30 crores is a bank loan and INR20 crores was funded through the IPO, internal accruals, and unsecured loans from promoters.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's net worth stood at around INR42 crores as of December end.
capital_allocation.quote: So by December end our net worth stood at around INR42 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: US dollar exchange rate movements introduce currency risk to raw material import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Elevated inventory levels of around INR 29 crores are maintained due to stocking 108 imported products across national godowns.
risks_headwinds.quote: Basically, we are importing 108 products, and we are having a multiple office in all over India basis, so we have to keep the inventory so far as our import is concerned.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex expects to reach 100% capacity utilization at its plant by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company prioritizes scaling manufacturing to contribute 50% of revenue in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to fully eliminate company debt using internal accruals.
The company plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to achieve full capacity utilization by the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.claim: Trading and manufacturing revenue mix is expected to reach an equal 50-50 split within 1 and 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
